toeic_zh: 新規定要求工廠將碳排放減少百分之三十。

en: a measuring instrument
toeic: Digital gauges measure dimensions precisely.
toeic_zh: 數字量規精確測量尺寸。

en: not working or not being used
toeic: Half of the equipment sat idle during the strike.
toeic_zh: 罷工期間有一半設備閒置。

en: to shape something in a mold
simple: Mold the plastic at high temperature.
toeic: Injection machines mold parts rapidly.
toeic_zh: 注射機快速模製零件。

en: to examine and repair or change something completely
simple: They will overhaul the old engine.
simple_zh: 他們會徹底檢修這具舊引擎。
toeic: The company will overhaul its assembly line to cut waste.
toeic_zh: 公司將全面改造其裝配線以減少浪費。
family: overhaul (n) 大修；全面改革；major overhaul 大幅改造

en: the degree of exactness and refinement
toeic: Precision manufacturing requires skilled workers.
toeic_zh: 精密製造需要熟練的工人。

en: the first model of a new product, used for testing
simple: He made a prototype of the toy.
simple_zh: 他做了一個玩具的原型。
toeic: The engineers will present a working prototype at next week's meeting.
toeic_zh: 工程師將在下週的會議上展示可運作的原型機。
family: build/test a prototype 製作／測試原型；working prototype 可運作的原型機

en: the act of refusing to accept something
toeic: High rejection rates reduce profitability.
toeic_zh: 高拒絕率降低獲利能力。

en: a machine that can do tasks automatically
simple_zh: 一個機器人打掃我們的地板。
toeic: A welding robot now does the work that three people used to do.
toeic_zh: 現在一台焊接機器人做原本三個人做的工作。

en: to save useful parts or goods from something damaged
simple: We can salvage some old wood.
simple_zh: 我們可以回收一些舊木頭。
toeic: Workers managed to salvage most of the stock after the flood.
toeic_zh: 水災後，工人設法搶救出大部分庫存。

en: a device that detects changes
toeic: IoT sensors monitor equipment performance.
toeic_zh: 物聯網傳感器監控設備性能。

en: the imitation of something
toeic: Manufacturing simulations predict outcomes.
toeic_zh: 製造模擬預測結果。

en: cloth or fabric made by weaving or knitting
simple: She works in the textile business.
toeic: The textile exports from our region rose by eight percent this quarter.
toeic_zh: 本季我們地區的紡織品出口成長了百分之八。

en: the amount of variation allowed
toeic: Parts must be within tolerance limits.
toeic_zh: 零件必須在誤差範圍內。

en: Related to sound that is heard.
toeic: The audio equipment in the conference room needs repair.
toeic_zh: 會議室的音響設備需要維修。

en: The work of growing crops and raising animals.
toeic: The company supplies advanced equipment to the agriculture industry.
toeic_zh: 該公司向農業產業供應先進設備。

en: Happening immediately.
toeic: The new software gives instant access to customer records.
toeic_zh: 這套新軟體能立即存取客戶紀錄。

en: An area of knowledge, or a web address name.
simple: This is her area of domain.
toeic: Our company registered a new domain for the online store.
toeic_zh: 我們公司為網路商店註冊了新網域。

en: A vehicle that flies into space.
toeic: The company builds rocket parts for the space industry.
toeic_zh: 這家公司為太空產業製造火箭零件。

zh: 第一階段；希臘字母 α
en: the first letter of the Greek alphabet
simple: Alpha is the first Greek letter.
simple_zh: Alpha 是第一個希臘字母。
toeic: The software is still in its alpha stage of testing.
toeic_zh: 這套軟體仍處於 alpha 測試階段。

en: made by people, not natural
toeic: The firm invests heavily in artificial intelligence technology.
toeic_zh: 公司大量投資於人工智慧技術。

en: a complete change in form or nature
simple: The city has seen a big transformation.
simple_zh: 這座城市有了很大的轉變。
toeic: Digital transformation has changed how we serve customers.
toeic_zh: 數位轉型改變了我們服務客戶的方式。

en: easy to hurt or attack
simple: Small shops are vulnerable to price wars.
simple_zh: 小型商店容易受到價格戰的衝擊。
toeic: The old system is vulnerable to cyber attacks.
toeic_zh: 舊系統容易受到網路攻擊。

en: a test version of software before release
toeic: The beta version will be tested by selected users next week.
toeic_zh: 測試版將於下週由特定使用者進行測試。

en: a strong narrow beam of light
toeic: The factory uses a laser to cut precise parts.
toeic_zh: 工廠使用雷射切割精密零件。

en: a small piece used to cover or fix something
simple: He put a patch on his jeans.
simple_zh: 他在牛仔褲上縫了一塊補丁。
toeic: The IT team released a security patch this morning.
toeic_zh: 資訊團隊今早發布了一個安全性修補程式。

en: the act of studying a new place or idea
toeic: The company invested in oil exploration in the North Sea.
toeic_zh: 公司投資了北海的石油探勘。

en: a pattern of crossing lines, or a power network
simple: Draw a grid on the paper.
toeic: The storm damaged the city's power grid.
toeic_zh: 暴風雨損壞了這座城市的電網。

en: the act of starting to use or accept something
simple: The adoption of the new rule was quick.
simple_zh: 新規定很快就被採用了。
toeic: The adoption of cloud software saved us money.
toeic_zh: 採用雲端軟體為我們省下了經費。

en: having the power to attract metal
toeic: The magnetic strip on the card stores your account data.
toeic_zh: 卡片上的磁條儲存著您的帳戶資料。

en: a small picture on a screen
simple: Click the icon on the screen.
toeic: Click the printer icon to print the invoice.
toeic_zh: 點選印表機圖示即可列印發票。

en: dishonest, or damaged (of data)
toeic: A corrupt file prevented the software from opening.
toeic_zh: 一個損毀的檔案使軟體無法開啟。

en: the movement of people or animals to another place
toeic: Data migration to the new server will finish tonight.
toeic_zh: 資料遷移到新伺服器今晚將完成。

en: the way a user or system connects with a computer
simple: The phone has an easy interface.
simple_zh: 這支手機的介面很容易使用。
toeic: The new software has a user-friendly interface that saves training time.
toeic_zh: 新軟體的介面對使用者很友善，可節省訓練時間。

en: according to exact rules or technical details
simple: Technically, the shop is closed now.
simple_zh: 嚴格來說，這家店現在打烊了。
toeic: The product is technically sound but needs a better design.
toeic_zh: 這項產品在技術上沒有問題，但設計還需改進。

en: the way something is arranged or installed
simple: The setup of the room took an hour.
simple_zh: 布置這個房間花了一小時。
toeic: The setup of the new network will take two days.
toeic_zh: 新網路的架設將需要兩天。

en: the act of finding or noticing something
simple_zh: 及早發現可以救人一命。
toeic: The system improves the detection of errors in the data.
toeic_zh: 這個系統提升了資料錯誤的偵測能力。

en: a thin thread of material; dietary roughage
simple: Fruit has a lot of fiber.
toeic: The company installed fiber cables to speed up the network.
toeic_zh: 公司安裝了光纖纜線以加快網路速度。

en: related to technology
simple: We live in a technological age.
toeic: Technological advances have changed how we do business.
toeic_zh: 科技進步改變了我們做生意的方式。

en: the ability to move or travel easily
simple: The old man has poor mobility.
toeic: The new app improves mobility for workers who travel often.
toeic_zh: 這個新應用程式為經常出差的員工提升了行動便利性。

en: to stop or come to an end
toeic: The factory will cease production of this model in June.
toeic_zh: 工廠將於六月停止生產這個型號。

en: the time or act of gathering crops
simple: The harvest was good this year.
toeic: A poor harvest raised the price of rice.
toeic_zh: 收成不佳使米價上漲。

en: a set of steps a computer follows to solve a problem
simple: The app uses a smart algorithm.
simple_zh: 這個應用程式使用聰明的演算法。
toeic: Our search algorithm shows customers the most relevant products.
toeic_zh: 我們的搜尋演算法會向顧客顯示最相關的產品。

en: wood used for building
simple: The house is made of timber.
simple_zh: 這間房子是用木材建造的。
toeic: The company imports timber for its furniture factory.
toeic_zh: 該公司為家具工廠進口木材。

en: in a natural state; rough and simple
simple: Crude oil comes from under the ground.
toeic: The price of crude oil rose sharply this week.
toeic_zh: 本週原油價格大幅上漲。

en: the act of getting in the way of something
simple: Radio interference made the call hard.
simple_zh: 無線電干擾使通話很困難。
toeic: Government interference delayed the merger by several months.
toeic_zh: 政府的干預使合併延後了數個月。

en: a quantity with direction; a carrier of disease
simple: A vector has size and direction.
toeic: Mosquitoes are a common vector for spreading disease.
toeic_zh: 蚊子是傳播疾病的常見媒介。

en: the way parts of a system are arranged or set up
toeic: The technician changed the network configuration to improve speed.
toeic_zh: 技術人員更改了網路配置以提升速度。

en: without stopping
simple: The machine ran continuously all day.
toeic: The plant operates continuously to meet the high demand.
toeic_zh: 工廠為了滿足高需求而持續運轉。

en: the edge of a country, or the limit of new knowledge
toeic: The firm is pushing the frontier of renewable energy research.
toeic_zh: 該公司正在拓展再生能源研究的新領域。

en: made by people using chemicals, not natural
simple: This shirt is made of synthetic fiber.
simple_zh: 這件襯衫是合成纖維做的。
toeic: The factory switched to synthetic materials to cut production costs.
toeic_zh: 工廠改用合成材料以降低生產成本。

en: made of several different parts
simple: The wall is made of composite material.
simple_zh: 這面牆是用複合材料做的。
toeic: The aircraft uses a composite material that is light but strong.
toeic_zh: 這架飛機使用輕但堅固的複合材料。

en: best or most suitable
simple: This is the optimal time to buy.
simple_zh: 現在是購買的最佳時機。
toeic: Keep the machine at an optimal temperature for best results.
toeic_zh: 請將機器維持在最佳溫度以獲得最佳效果。

en: strong and able to work well
toeic: The system must be robust enough to handle heavy traffic.
toeic_zh: 系統必須夠穩健，才能承受大量流量。

en: to stop or make something stop
toeic: Production was halted because of the power failure.
toeic_zh: 由於停電，生產被迫中斷。

en: the act of putting people or things into use
simple: The deployment of new staff starts today.
simple_zh: 新員工的調派今天開始。
toeic: The deployment of the new software will take two weeks.
toeic_zh: 新軟體的部署將需要兩週。

en: a person who is first to do or develop something
simple: She is a pioneer in science.
toeic: The firm is a pioneer in electric vehicle technology.
toeic_zh: 該公司是電動車技術的先驅。

en: flat and level, from side to side
toeic: The chart shows time on the horizontal axis.
toeic_zh: 圖表在水平軸上顯示時間。

en: a program used to look at web pages
toeic: Please update your browser to use the online booking system.
toeic_zh: 請更新您的瀏覽器以使用線上訂位系統。

en: A machine or company that processes something
simple: This phone has a fast processor.
simple_zh: 這支手機的處理器很快。
toeic: The new processor makes the laptop run much faster.
toeic_zh: 新的處理器讓這台筆電運作快很多。

en: Working or in effect
simple: The new rule is now operative.
toeic: The agreement will become operative on January 1.
toeic_zh: 該協議將於一月一日生效。

en: An important new discovery or achievement
toeic: The engineers announced a breakthrough in battery technology.
toeic_zh: 工程師宣布電池技術有重大突破。

en: A device that produces nuclear power
toeic: The nuclear reactor was shut down for safety checks.
toeic_zh: 核反應爐因安全檢查而關閉。

en: Together with another person or group
toeic: The two companies jointly developed the new software.
toeic_zh: 兩家公司共同開發了這套新軟體。

en: stiff, not easy to bend or change
simple: The metal bar is very rigid.
toeic: The company's rigid schedule leaves little room for last-minute changes.
toeic_zh: 公司嚴格的時程幾乎沒有臨時更動的餘地。

en: to put people or things into use
simple: They deploy more staff on weekends.
simple_zh: 他們週末會調派更多人手。
toeic: The IT team will deploy the new software across all branches.
toeic_zh: 資訊團隊將在所有分公司部署新軟體。

en: fast internet connection
toeic: The hotel offers free broadband in every guest room.
toeic_zh: 這家飯店每間客房都提供免費寬頻。

en: very careful and strict
toeic: All products go through rigorous quality checks before shipping.
toeic_zh: 所有產品出貨前都經過嚴格的品質檢驗。

en: owned by a company and legally protected
toeic: Employees must not share proprietary information with competitors.
toeic_zh: 員工不得向競爭對手洩露專有資訊。

en: the process of taking in a substance or idea
simple: The sponge helps with water absorption.
toeic: The absorption of the smaller firm will be completed by June.
toeic_zh: 對這家小公司的併購整合將於六月完成。

en: to make something happen faster
toeic: New machines will accelerate the production process.
toeic_zh: 新機器將加快生產流程。

en: based on ideas rather than real things
simple: This is only a conceptual drawing.
toeic: The team presented a conceptual design for the new product.
toeic_zh: 團隊提出了新產品的概念設計。

en: based on real tests or experience
simple_zh: 我們需要先有實證資料。
toeic: The study provides empirical evidence that the training works.
toeic_zh: 這項研究提供了訓練有效的實證證據。

en: continuing forever without stopping
toeic: The software comes with a perpetual license.
toeic_zh: 這套軟體附有永久授權。

en: able to stretch and return to shape
toeic: Demand for luxury goods is not very elastic.
toeic_zh: 奢侈品的需求彈性不大。

en: a part of something; a voter
simple: Water is a constituent of milk.
toeic: Each constituent of the product must be tested.
toeic_zh: 產品的每個成分都必須經過測試。

en: the business of phone and data networks
simple: My brother works for a telecom firm.
simple_zh: 我哥哥在電信公司工作。
toeic: The telecom company announced a new data plan.
toeic_zh: 這家電信公司發表了新的數據方案。

en: a limit or fixed setting for something

toeic_zh: 專案必須維持在預算範圍內。

en: a change that makes something false or unclear
simple_zh: 這面鏡子會讓影像失真。
toeic: The audio system produces no distortion at high volume.
toeic_zh: 這套音響在大音量下不會失真。

en: to copy or repeat exactly
toeic: Other firms cannot easily replicate our production method.
toeic_zh: 其他公司很難複製我們的生產方法。

en: best possible for a situation
simple: This is the optimum time to go.
toeic: Keep the machine at its optimum temperature for best results.
toeic_zh: 請將機器維持在最佳溫度以獲得最好的結果。

en: to make something firmer or stricter
toeic: The company will tighten its security after the data leak.
toeic_zh: 資料外洩後，公司將加強安全措施。
